recommendation: Measure exact feature-valid state reuse before changing the model. Build a hash-consed full-depth upward/downward cavity computation DAG from native interval edge changes. Recompute its learned values within every forward/optimizer update. If current-feature reuse is weak, separately register a factorized structural genealogy encoder plus position-local SNP correction as a changed model; do not label that an exact TreeLoom optimization.

current_bottleneck.interpretation: The current observation bank duplicates native nodes across marginal trees. Global nodes/edges are far smaller, but structural redundancy does not establish numeric hidden-state redundancy. Two learned tree sweeps and their backward passes dominate warm wall time.

exact_dependency_signatures.base: Exact node-age/root/sampled primitive features plus, for sampled leaves, the complete site-pooling source computation, hold span, observed reference role and sample age. Persistent sample column stays in the source/routing key for the conservative census.
exact_dependency_signatures.upward: Shared learned operator identity, base dependency ID, parent degree, and ordered child pairs of upward-state ID and exact upward-gate source ID. Preserve original reduction order.
exact_dependency_signatures.edge_message: Child upward ID, upward gate source, parent degree and shared weight identity.
exact_dependency_signatures.outside: Parent outside ID, parent base ID, parent full aggregate ID, recipient upward edge-message ID and exact downward-gate source ID. Preserve full-parent-sum minus recipient algebra, rather than replacing it with a differently ordered sibling sum.
exact_dependency_signatures.second_sweep: All first-sweep dependencies plus exact clade flags, own-state episode eligibility and sample-memory injection dependencies. These generally invalidate first-sweep sharing.
exact_dependency_signatures.training: Never cache numeric states across optimizer updates. A shared operation must retain all multiplicities in autograd. Numeric equality alone does not prove identical input Jacobians.

input_interface.format: Observed-only NPZ arrays plus bounded JSON provenance; no truth fields
features: genotype and all existing donor/panel/call/entropy arrays in original dtypes
input_interface.identity: A sample column identifies the same observed haplotype at every genomic interval. Never merge the output rows or recurrent histories of different haplotypes. Native internal node IDs route computation; they are not learned embeddings.
input_interface.position: Keep original half-open marginal intervals, exact physical widths, SNP positions and focal coordinates. No window center substitutes for the original readout coordinate.
input_interface.dependency_policy: Strict source-identity census gives a conservative guaranteed-reuse count. It does not prove that a more extensive canonical primitive-input graph has no further reuse.

complexity.symbols: T trees, H samples, N expanded node occurrences, E native interval edges, V native global nodes, S SNPs, d hidden width, U distinct upward operations, D distinct outside operations, M distinct upward messages, P distinct leaf-context pairs
complexity.current: Per learned sweep O(N*d^2 + N*d); expanded metadata O(N); dense contexts O(T*H*d). Multiple sweeps, checkpoint recomputation and full sequence decoder add their existing costs.
complexity.prototype: Packet compilation O(N + expanded edges) with exact tuple signatures; batched DAG evaluation O((U+D+M+P)*d^2), activations proportional to unique operations plus routing maps. This prototype deliberately uses a bounded packet rather than a production all-parent builder.
complexity.production_builder: Stream tskit edge diffs and persistent child sets to avoid expanded-bank construction. Upward changes invalidate ancestors; outside/cavity changes may invalidate most of a tree. Worst case remains O(N*d^2), not O(E). DAG identity alone does not remove the T*H output/GRU floor.
complexity.storage: Native observations remain O(V+E+S*H); DAG and query/sample interval routing add O(U+D+M+P). Dense per-tree maps may be replaced by exact runs only when their routing/value dependencies are identical.

alternatives.interval_edge_K_layer_GNN: One interval-annotated global node state is not an exact tree state: it mixes edges that may never coexist at one position. Correctness requires interval-specific states or explicit positional queries. K local layers miss deep reference-to-query paths and impose a changed model; many layers risk oversmoothing.
alternatives.window_approximation: Window pooling merges topology and SNP evidence on both sides of real recombination/ancestry transitions. Genomic position embeddings do not restore discarded conditional structure. Report tract-length and breakpoint error versus distance to a boundary, alongside ancestry accuracy and calibration.
alternatives.factorized_candidate: Full-depth reference/age/geometry structural cavity DAG plus a position-local, all-observed-SNP readout and persistent-sample genomic sequence model. Reuse is enabled by separating features, but late genotype injection may lose mutation-conditioned lineage reasoning. This is an accuracy/efficiency tradeoff to test, not an exact rewrite.

known_components: Succinct tree sequences and interval edge diffs
Hash-consing/common-subexpression elimination and incremental dynamic programming
Full-depth tree/cavity message passing and rerooting
Autograd gradient accumulation through shared expressions
Feature factorization, local SNP evidence and sample-aligned sequence models
scientific_position.candidate_contribution: A measured, gradient-verified reuse scheme and its end-to-end accuracy/efficiency tradeoff on the same observed data. Hash-consing alone is not a new learned operator.
scientific_position.ledger_constraints: H036/H038 establish the existing cavity/SNP/GRU family. H042 local topology flags exceeded more elaborate paired-clade controls; H043/H045 foreign-state/episode benefits were below utility criteria; H044 already examined position-local SNP readout; H050 higher-order history utility failed. Do not rebrand these components or assume improvement.
scientific_position.acceptance: Same observed data, persistent sample/query identities, held-out ancestry accuracy and boundary metrics, preparation wall time, training/inference throughput, CPU/GPU peak memory, and total cost including caches/compilation. No simulation-core changes, superiority assumption or novelty claim.
